title: Tech Note: Generating a Listbox using Dynamic forms
author: Vance Villanueva, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: Building list boxes purely from JSON via Dynamic Forms remains a valid, still-current 4D technique; the four data-source styles compared (current selection, array, collection, entity selection) are all still supported in 4D today, though collection/entity-selection-based list boxes are now generally the preferred modern approach over classic selection/array binding.
related_updates: Dynamic Forms and JSON-defined list boxes remain fully supported and current
ORDA collection/entity-selection-based list boxes have become the more common modern pattern versus classic current-selection or array-based list boxes
no deprecated APIs in this note; all four list box data-source types remain valid, though ORDA-based patterns are now favored for new development
